content: समर्थ {%a.%} .²1 Strong, powerful. .²2 Competent, capable of, qualified; प्रतिग्रहसमर्थोऽपि <ls>Ms. 4. 186</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 213</ls>. .²3 Fit, suitable, proper; किं समर्थं जनस्यास्य किं प्रियं किं सुखावहम् <ls>Rām. 2. 57. 14</ls>; तद्धनुर्ग्रहणमेव राघवः प्रत्यपद्यत समर्थमुत्तरम् <ls>R. 11. 79</ls>. .²4 Made fit or proper, prepared. .²5 Having the same meaning. .²6 Significant. .²7 Having proper aim or force, very forcible. .²8 Being in apposition. .²9 Connected in sense. .{@-र्थः@} .²1 A significant word (in <ab>gram.</ab>); अव्ययं समर्थेन सह समस्यते सोऽव्ययीभावः <ls>Sk.</ls> .²2 The coherence of words together in a significant sentence. .{@-र्थम्@} .²1 Ability, competence. .²2 Intelligibility.
